objects.description: [MuddyViper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9032) has the ability to establish persistence by configuring its installation directory as a Windows Startup folder by setting the following Registry values to `%APPDATALOCAL%\Microsoft\Windows\PPBCompatCache\ManagerCache`:  `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders\Startup` and `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders\Startup`.(Citation: ESET_MuddyWater_Dec2025)
